# Extract a selected component instead of relabeling a world

The managed installer existed without a user-facing producer or consumer.
The legacy library could not describe or install a real Godot file set.

Add a separate Godot library page and a read-only source extractor. Use the
actual main scene and select an identifiable node subtree. Include its concrete
scene resources and scripts; represent shared named base classes as exact
receiving-source requirements. Install through the existing atomic managed
source transaction, then use the real check/preview/apply workflow.

The first bounded slice refuses structures it cannot safely separate, instead
of exporting an entire world as a component or fabricating dependency support.
Cross-world authored-door acceptance verifies preserved collision/mesh, script
inheritance and two independently interactive instances in the pinned engine.
It remains separate from final native gateway and real-model acceptance.
